protocol: Rible corrected-export within-movie shape transfer v1
base: Original absolute-unit/segmentation comparison 9edf4aeb closed before other movies; source refusal 5618ec25. This question is dimensionless and does not certify pixel or mm metrology. No camera2 or held camera1 scientific row read before this freeze.
course: 48 development and 24 held whole physical movie pairs. Source R1_DW_Green debug exposure belongs only to development. Same fluid/nozzle repeated conditions; no new-treatment or independent apparatus claim.
allowed: Both corrected camera exports for development; only corrected camera1 shape descriptors from all held movies can enter forecasts. Held target cam2 bbox_heigth distribution is used only by the receiver after all forecast bytes are locked. It computes its own median as part of defining the measured response. No target prefix, time fit, masks or rejection chosen from measurements.
endpoint: 19 natural-log empirical quantile ratios log(Q(p)/Q(.5)), p=k/20, k=1,...,19, inverse empirical CDF via ceil(k*n/20)-1. Target vertical support proxy is corrected Camera2 bbox_heigth. Source full movie used retrospectively. Zero fixed median counted for every role including fitted ones. Physical ideal horizontal orthographic views share the same vertical support for all shape sets; positive constant camera magnifications cancel in every ratio. If both movies cover the same temporal distribution, exact common-shape forecasts follow. Different length, sampling windows, segmentation masks, additive offsets, spatial distortion and frame-dependent scale remain competing errors. No alignment or causal forecasting claim.
rows: Retain all 72 movie names. Require sequential frame numbers starting1, finite positive relevant sizes, finite angle; never truncate to shorter partner or deduplicate equal outcomes. Index-level reproducibility and repeated rows tracked. Record data-row counts, including deviations from metadata. Per-camera median is the single even-quantile order statistic convention, no interpolated median.

roles.ellipse: camera1 per-frame sqrt((majorAxis sin a)^2+(minorAxis cos a)^2), cantingAngle in degrees, then normalized quantiles. Tests conditional ellipse approximation, no recovered 3D mode claim.
roles.chord: camera1 normalized verticalAxis, the author column distinct from bbox_heigth
roles.condition: 2 development camera2 log-quantile curves averaged within same fluid/nozzle
roles.affine: pooled through-origin scalar LS target log-quantile on source common_support, over 48x19 rows. Zero center enforced.
roles.multifeature: pooled through-origin ridge of common_support, ellipse, chord, horizontal_sham plus the development camera2 group mean (leave self out for fitted training rows). Equal whole-movie weights. Gram normalized by number of rows. Fixed grid 0.000001,0.0001,0.01,1; choose smallest dev twofold RMSE with ties in increasing grid order; for each of the two within-condition replicates as a test fold use only the other for condition training, and use all-condition mean in training features if there is zero within-group other; frozen final fit takes all48. True held uses both group dev profiles. Pure Python 5x5 regularized linear solve.

gate: Literal support RMS < every other role by equal-weight mean of 24 within-movie 19-coordinate RMS; >12 strictly smaller errors vs affine and multi-feature separately, no numerical tolerances for wins. Same worst actual coordinate for comparison across every role. Report both winners and losses, no population significance.
additional: Full empirical W2 between per-camera log(height/Q(.5)) distributions is a lower bound on any equal-mass temporal correspondence for each whole movie; exact quantile-jump integration. Report worst finite W2 on each complete movie and separately ordinal prefix RMS. Unequal-length prefix and full-distribution W2 use different empirical marginals. Repeat counts are descriptor repeats, never declared independent frames. Primary is a 19-coordinate score, not the full W2.
preservation: All 24x8x19 binary64 forecast bytes, member roster, source lengths, repeated rows, source distinct log-box counts and complete source-only calibration coefficients precede any target decode. Persist fitting, forecast and scoring code and worst case. Absolute registered measurement/source gate remains closed. No per-camera raw measurements republished.
